tokens.v: Full-bleed photograph filling the entire frame edge to edge. The bottle stands submerged on pale sand, shot from below its shoulder looking up so Snell's window opens above it — the sky compressed into a bright circle rimmed by mirrored blue, a caustic net raking down the glass and dancing on the sand. 35mm at f/5.6 underwater, fine bubbles streaming off the crown cap toward the surface with a faint upward smear, the water column glowing turquoise to deep blue at the edges. BASALT BLOOM reads lithographed on the cap where a caustic band crosses it; a drifting seagrass blade blurs through the bottom-right corner, cut by the edge.
